recipe.hypothesis: Normal-start A20 Act1-2 Win PPO can begin learning second-act survival using the existing architecture and adjacent-stage weight transfer.
recipe.control: Frozen SHA-pinned Act1 parent evaluated from normal starts through Act2 on the same development-confirmation seeds and runtime.
recipe.training_changes: New horizon and fresh stage initialization; retain all model weights, reset Adam/RNG/workers/memory, inherit cumulative steps. Preserve parent PPO scalars and architecture. Bind the reviewed Snecko rule correction; frozen parent and candidate are both evaluated under corrected Act2 semantics.
recipe.success_rule: Healthy complete budget; true ACT_2_CLEARED training outcomes in both disjoint late windows [2M,3M) and [3M,4M+rollout]; primary fixed endpoint paired development improvement >=0.02 with approximate paired 95% lower bound >0. One training seed, simulator evidence only.
recipe.failure_rule: Incomplete budget is INCOMPLETE. Other results are INCONCLUSIVE or NO_DEVELOPMENT_GAIN; inspect true-success windows, natural Act2 entries and value diagnostics before any extension. Greedy evaluation calibration is descriptive, not on-policy critic proof.
recipe.final_policy: Keep final seeds sealed. This pilot's endpoint and selected checkpoint use development confirmation only.
recipe.selection_candidates: Only checkpoints actually evaluated on the periodic development block; fixed endpoint is primary and is not implicitly included in periodic selection.
recipe.diagnostics: Existing termination_success metrics binned into disjoint late windows; evaluation records first decision per act, HP/deck/relic/potions, shaped critic value and potential. No policy-input, action or reward change.

decision_note: Use the preregistered 90M fixed endpoint: paired 2048-seed +3.22pp over 70M, no confirmed selected76 advantage; current normal-start Act2 probe demonstrates a true success, motivating a 4M adjacent-stage adaptation pilot.
